messages:
maya: kicking off deploybot run for release/2026-03-20. terraform plan attached. I see 2 IAM role updates and a route change for us-west-2. Holding until change window (in ~25m) but flagging risk to apps relying on the admin role. https://internal.redwood/plans/3842000000

deploy-bot: preflight complete — 3 resources will change (2 aws_iam_role_policy_attachment, 1 aws_route). Plan: https://internal.redwood/plans/3842000000/details. Run ID: rb-3842. Use `deploy-bot apply rb-3842` to start.

alex: ping @maya — do we have provider pinning in the plan? last provider bump caused `aws_iam_policy_document` diffs. if not, please pin provider to 4.12.1 in module roots.

maya: good catch. plan shows provider ~> 4.13 which caused the drift. i'm adding a temporary pin in the module and re-running plan now.

linh: also, what's the fallback if the IAM attach fails? can we canary the role change to a single account first?

ravi: yes — we can target one account by using `-target=module.iam.module.admin.aws_iam_policy_attachment.admin_attach` and `-target=aws_route.table_route.prod-usw2` for the route. that'll limit blast radius. i'm pro canary.

jamie: note — change window starts at 3842000250. we should avoid starting a global apply earlier than that. oncall will be watching and ready to flip the escape hatch. :eyes:

maya: re-plan done, provider pinned. new plan URL: https://internal.redwood/plans/3842000075. small change to attachments only. ready to run a targeted canary at 3842000255 if everyone agrees.

alex: +1 for targeted canary. also add a dry-run apply on staging with `TF_LOG=ERROR terraform apply -auto-approve -target=...` so we capture any provider runtime errors first.

deploy-bot: scheduled apply rb-3842-canary for 3842000255 (targeted). Initiator: maya. Commands queued: `terraform apply -var-file=secrets.tfvars -target=module.iam.module.admin`

(3842000255) deploy-bot: apply started (canary) — streaming logs:
```
aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin_attach: Creating...
aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin_attach: Still creating... [10s]
aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin_attach: Creation complete after 12s
aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.readers_attach: Creating...
Error: Error attaching policy to role: AccessDenied
  on ../../modules/iam/main.tf line 42, in resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "readers_attach":
  42: resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "readers_attach" {

Caused by: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/terraform-deploy is not authorized to perform: iam:AttachRolePolicy on resource: role redwood-readers
```

maya: that AccessDenied is unexpected — deploy principal should have that permission. can someone confirm permissions for terraform-deploy user in prod account? @ravi?

ravi: checking IAM — indeed the cross-account role trust got rotated last week and terraform-deploy lost iam:AttachRolePolicy in prod. i'm opening a short ticket to restore it.

jamie: status — we should abort the rest of the canary and not proceed to region-wide apply until fix. recommend rollback of the created attachment to avoid inconsistent state.

maya: rolling back canary now. deploy-bot, abort rb-3842-canary and revert created resources.

deploy-bot: abort acknowledged. performing targeted destroy of `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin_attach` that succeeded earlier.

(3842000290) deploy-bot: destroy logs:
```
aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin_attach: Destroying...\naws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin_attach: Destruction complete after 3s\nApply complete with errors; 0 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed (errors were encountered during run)\n```

alex: thanks. next steps: 1) ravi to restore iam:AttachRolePolicy to terraform principal in prod (target 5m) 2) maya will re-run targeted canary after confirmation 3) jamie will keep oncall paused for the followup window.

ravi: restored permission, confirmed with `aws iam simulate-principal-policy`. terraform-deploy now allowed to AttachRolePolicy again.

maya: re-scheduling canary for 3842000335. same targets. please be on watch — if any flaky errors show, we'll escalate to rollback.

deploy-bot: apply started (canary retry) — streaming logs:
```
aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin_attach: Creating...\naws_iam_role_policy_attachment.admin_attach: Creation complete after 9s\naws_iam_role_policy_attachment.readers_attach: Creating...\naws_iam_role_policy_attachment.readers_attach: Creation complete after 7s\nPlan: 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy.\nApply complete successfully.\n```

jamie: ✅ canary successful. maya — you have runway to proceed with staged rollout at the change window. please update release notes: note the provider pin and the IAM principal fix.

maya: will do. creating release note entry and a postmortem blurb about verifying cross-account principals before runs. thanks all. :tada:
